display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Dubai puts you in the captain's seat over the real city.

THE REAL DUBAI
The coastline, the terrain and thousands of buildings come from real satellite and map data. Fly round the Burj Khalifa, along the Palm Jumeirah, past the Burj Al Arab and Ain Dubai, over The World islands and down the Marina skyline. Cars stream along the motorways, yachts and ships work the Gulf and other aircraft share the sky.

THREE REAL AIRPORTS
Dubai International with both runways, Al Maktoum International and Sharjah International, with their real taxiways and approach lights.

THE PRIVATE JET
An ultra-long-range jet with a glass cockpit: live flight displays, a moving map and an autopilot. Fly it with the side-stick and thrust levers in your hands, or with the thumbsticks. Then stand up and walk back through the cabin while the city goes by outside the windows.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
The private jet, a twin-engine fighter, a four-seat light plane and a helicopter. Each has its own cockpit and its own way of flying.

YOUR OWN HANGAR
Walk around your aircraft, repaint them and power wash them clean, then choose one and fly.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Landings at all three airports, a ring course round the Palm, a skyline run past the Burj Khalifa, a night landing and a city tour - or just fly, by day, at sunset or at night.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Join up on a friend's wing or ride in their aircraft. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
